subject: general
question: Excluding stoppages, the speed of a bus is 45 kmph and including stoppages, it is 27 kmph. For how many minutes does the bus stop per hour?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Required time for the stoppage per hour = Difference of speed/speed without stoppage Speed of the bus (excluding stoppages) = 45 km/h Speed of the bus (including stoppages) = 27 km/h Required time for the stoppage per hour = (45 - 27)/45 = 18/45 = 2/5 × 60 = 24 minutes. ∴ The bus stops per hour for 24 min.
